text_en: The Lord said to Moses:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Tell the Israelites to take for me an offering; from all whose hearts prompt them to give you shall receive the offering for me.
text_cn: “你吩咐以色列子民，叫他们送给我献仪。凡甘心乐捐的人，你们可以收下他们献于我的献仪。

text_en: This is the offering that you shall receive from them: gold, silver, and bronze,
text_cn: 以下是你们要接收的献仪：金银铜，

text_en: blue, purple, and crimson yarns and fine linen, goats’ hair,
text_cn: 紫色、红色、朱红色的毛线，细麻和山羊毛，

text_en: tanned rams’ skins, fine leather, acacia wood,
text_cn: 染红的公羊皮、海豚皮和皂荚木，

text_en: oil for the lamps, spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense,
text_cn: 灯油，为傅礼用的油和焚香的香料，

text_en: onyx stones and gems to be set in the ephod and for the breastpiece.
text_cn: 红玛瑙石和为镶在‘厄弗得’和胸牌上的各种宝石。

text_en: And have them make me a sanctuary, so that I may dwell among them.
text_cn: 他们要为我建造一座圣所，好让我住在他们中间。

text_en: In accordance with all that I show you concerning the pattern of the tabernacle and of all its furniture, so you shall make it.
text_cn: 我现今指示你作帐棚和其中一切器皿的式样，要完全按照式样去制造。

text_en: They shall make an ark of acacia wood; it shall be two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.
text_cn: 应用皂荚木制造一个柜，长二肘半，宽一肘半，高一肘半；

text_en: You shall overlay it with pure gold, inside and outside you shall overlay it, and you shall make a molding of gold upon it all around.
text_cn: 要内外全包上纯金，上端周围应镶上金花边。

text_en: You shall cast four rings of gold for it and put them on its four feet, two rings on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side.
text_cn: 铸四个金环，安在柜的脚上：这边两个，那边两个。

text_en: You shall make poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.
text_cn: 用皂荚木作两根杠杆，包上金；

text_en: And you shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, by which to carry the ark.
text_cn: 将杠杆穿入柜边的环内，作抬柜之用。

text_en: The poles shall remain in the rings of the ark; they shall not be taken from it.
text_cn: 穿入柜环内的杠杆，不可抽出。

text_en: You shall put into the ark the covenant that I shall give you.
text_cn: 将我要交给你的约版放在柜内。

text_en: Then you shall make a mercy seat of pure gold; two cubits and a half shall be its length, and a cubit and a half its width.
text_cn: 用纯金做赎罪盖，长二肘半，

text_en: You shall make two cherubim of gold; you shall make them of hammered work, at the two ends of the mercy seat.
text_cn: 宽一肘半。在赎罪盖的两端用锤工造一对金革鲁宾，

text_en: Make one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other; of one piece with the mercy seat you shall make the cherubim at its two ends.
text_cn: 在这端做一个革鲁宾，在那端做一个革鲁宾，应使两端的革鲁宾与赎罪盖连在一起。

text_en: The cherubim shall spread out their wings above, overshadowing the mercy seat with their wings. They shall face one to another; the faces of the cherubim shall be turned toward the mercy seat.
text_cn: 革鲁宾的翅膀应伸开遮住赎罪盖；他们的脸彼此相对，面朝赎罪盖。

text_en: You shall put the mercy seat on the top of the ark; and in the ark you shall put the covenant that I shall give you.
text_cn: 你把赎罪盖安装在约柜上面，将我交给你的约版放在柜内。

text_en: There I will meet with you, and from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim that are on the ark of the covenant, I will deliver to you all my commands for the Israelites.
text_cn: 我要在那里与你会晤，从赎罪盖上，从约柜上的两革鲁宾中间，将我命令以色列子民的一切事，都告诉给你。

text_en: You shall make a table of acacia wood, two cubits long, one cubit wide, and a cubit and a half high.
text_cn: 用皂荚木做一张供桌，长二肘，宽一肘，高一肘半，

text_en: You shall overlay it with pure gold, and make a molding of gold around it.
text_cn: 包上纯金，周围做上金花边。

text_en: You shall make around it a rim a handbreadth wide, and a molding of gold around the rim.
text_cn: 周围做上一掌宽的框子，框子四周也做上金花边。

text_en: You shall make for it four rings of gold, and fasten the rings to the four corners at its four legs.
text_cn: 还要作四个金环，将这些金环安在桌四脚的角上。

text_en: The rings that hold the poles used for carrying the table shall be close to the rim.
text_cn: 环子要靠近框子，为穿抬供桌的杠杆。

text_en: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold, and the table shall be carried with these.
text_cn: 用皂荚木做两根杠杆，包上金，为抬供桌之用。

text_en: You shall make its plates and dishes for incense, and its flagons and bowls with which to pour drink offerings; you shall make them of pure gold.
text_cn: 再制造供桌上的盘、碟、杯和奠祭用的爵，全用纯金制造。

text_en: And you shall set the bread of the Presence on the table before me always.
text_cn: 要常常在供桌上，在我面前摆上供饼。

text_en: You shall make a lampstand of pure gold. The base and the shaft of the lampstand shall be made of hammered work; its cups, its calyxes, and its petals shall be of one piece with it;
text_cn: 用纯金制造一座灯台，要用锤工打成这灯台；灯台灯干和花朵，即花托与花瓣，都应由灯台发出。

text_en: and there shall be six branches going out of its sides, three branches of the lampstand out of one side of it and three branches of the lampstand out of the other side of it;
text_cn: 灯台两面发出六叉：这面三叉，那面三叉。

text_en: three cups shaped like almond blossoms, each with calyx and petals, on one branch, and three cups shaped like almond blossoms, each with calyx and petals, on the other branch—so for the six branches going out of the lampstand.
text_cn: 在一叉上应有像杏花的三朵花，有花托和花瓣；在另一叉上应有像杏花的三朵花，有花托和花瓣；由灯台所发出的六叉都要这样。

text_en: On the lampstand itself there shall be four cups shaped like almond blossoms, each with its calyxes and petals.
text_cn: 在灯台的直干上应有像杏花的四个花朵，有花托和花瓣。

text_en: There shall be a calyx of one piece with it under the first pair of branches, a calyx of one piece with it under the next pair of branches, and a calyx of one piece with it under the last pair of branches—so for the six branches that go out of the lampstand.
text_cn: 由灯干发出的每两叉之下，各有一个花朵；从灯干发出的六个叉都应如此。

text_en: Their calyxes and their branches shall be of one piece with it, the whole of it one hammered piece of pure gold.
text_cn: 这些花朵和灯叉应由灯台发出，全用整块纯金锤成。

text_en: You shall make the seven lamps for it; and the lamps shall be set up so as to give light on the space in front of it.
text_cn: 灯台上应做七盏灯，把七盏灯放上，使光照耀灯台前面的空间。

text_en: Its snuffers and trays shall be of pure gold.
text_cn: 灯台的灯剪和碟子，应是纯金的。

text_en: It, and all these utensils, shall be made from a talent of pure gold.
text_cn: 为制造灯台和这些用具，应用一‘塔冷通’纯金。

text_en: And see that you make them according to the pattern for them, which is being shown you on the mountain.
text_cn: 要留神按照在山上指示给你的式样去做。
